what: File blocking after directory recall: block-once then soft-with-remaining-count. After first recall, future reads show "N more scoped memories not yet recalled" as soft nudge — agent knows what's outstanding and decides. Nothing silently lost. Also: anything running locally can be extracted — only server-side code is truly private. Pro features requiring code privacy must run server-side (API model).
why: User pushed back on block-once being sufficient — what if critical memories are missed? Soft-with-remaining-count keeps agent informed. Code privacy discussion confirmed server-side is only real option.
